description: Crunchtools dependency policy (constitution XV). Every repo gets it from
renovate/org-inherited-config.json, which the self-hosted run
(.github/workflows/renovate.yml) has each repo inherit, and which extends this at the v1 tag.
Renovate never touches .github/workflows: the github-actions manager is off and the
path is ignored (ignorePaths replaces config:recommended's list, so it is restated here).
A policy change here is one commit, and reaches every repo when v1 moves.
One PR per repo for everything that changes no major: minor and patch bumps,
and digest refreshes and pins, which keep the version they name. It merges
itself once the required checks pass.
These datasources give no release time to age against: docker outside
Docker Hub (quay, ghcr, Red Hat registries), git-tags, git-refs and
python-version. Under the default timestamp-required their updates would
wait forever, unseen with the dashboard off; here they wait only for the
weekly window.
Crunchtools refers to crunchtools at a moving tag (XV rule 5). Tool images
at :latest or :main are never pinned to a digest.
A new Python minor is a runtime migration, not a base refresh: a uv lock is
solved for one interpreter and compiled wheels ship per minor, so
hummingbird/python 3.14 -> 3.15 failed every trentina build (#874). Minor and
major tag bumps of the image are off; digest refreshes and patch bumps within
the tag still flow. The next minor moves by hand, with its lock.
